Description: Clarify that the 95.5 AIO Score and 99.2 Health Score are internal engineering heuristics rather than official Google ratings
Impact: External stakeholders or clients may misinterpret the metrics as official Google accreditations
Recommended Action: Update audit report templates and client dashboards to prominently include the disclaimer: 'Internal Optimization Heuristic Engine'

Description: Lack of documented human assistive-technology testing (NVDA on Windows; TalkBack on Android; VoiceOver on iOS)
Impact: Automated DOM checks only cover ~35% of WCAG criteria; potential non-compliance for motor or visually impaired users
Recommended Action: Conduct physical testing session with screen-reader hardware on mobile and desktop viewports and log results in an accessibility test matrix

Description: Real-world Core Web Vitals (CrUX field RUM) data is currently unavailable due to new domain traffic thresholds
Impact: Lab CLS (0.000) and LCP (0.4s-1.1s) may diverge from real-user mobile experiences on low-tier 3G/4G networks
Recommended Action: Configure automated weekly CrUX API polling and implement Cloudflare Web Analytics / GA4 web-vitals.js RUM telemetry

Description: Nomenclature confusion between 136 scanned files vs 129 production HTML files vs 113 canonical sitemap URLs
Impact: Auditors and technical staff spend unnecessary time reconciling inventory counts
Recommended Action: Standardize terminology across all documentation: 129 Core HTML Files; 113 Indexed Canonical URLs; 136 Audit-Scanned Artifacts

Description: IndexNow ping dispatches are verified but actual crawl/indexing rate by Bing and Yandex requires empirical monitoring
Impact: Assuming instant indexing can lead to false expectations regarding organic search ranking speed
Recommended Action: Integrate Microsoft Bing Webmaster API and Google Search Console URL Inspection API to record verified index status weekly

Description: Schema markup claims valid product aggregate ratings without an external third-party review collection provider
Impact: Google Search may suppress star ratings in search snippets if reviews are not independently verified
Recommended Action: Add clear editorial disclosure explaining that review scores reflect internal expert benchmarks until third-party review collection is integrated

Description: Lack of end-to-end browser gesture tests for dynamic client-side interactions (bundle calculator; finder modal; WhatsApp link)
Impact: Regressions in complex JavaScript event listeners could pass unit tests but fail for real users
Recommended Action: Implement a lightweight Playwright or Puppeteer E2E suite covering critical customer conversion funnels

Description: Static deployment allowlist gate requires manual hash/path updating when new product pages or images are added
Impact: Builds could fail closed during rapid content publishing if new paths are omitted from the allowlist
Recommended Action: Create an automated pre-commit hook that validates and updates the allowlist configuration when new markdown or html files are published
